(I'm supposed to go eat with Yuuto today,
but maybe I got here a little too early.)
Sorry I'm late!
Don't worry about it. I just got here.

I'm the one who invited you,
so I should've been here first.
I'm really sorry...

Hey, you don't have to beat yourself up
that much... I really don't mind.
But that doesn't sit right with me...

Even if you say that...
You're putting me on the spot...
...Was that your stomach growling...?

Ahaha...
To make up for being late, today's meal's on me.
Let's go. I know a great place.

Sure, let's go.
But I really don't mind, you know...
Um, so this place is... a cafe?
Yep. The food here is really good.

The portions are big, too.
Besides the hamburger steak, I'd also
recommend the curry or the gratin.
Uh-huh, uh-huh.

rows.en:
All right, let's see...
I'll have the cheese hamburger steak and a
large omurice. Extra ketchup on the omurice!
Wait, that's all for you, Yuuto...?
Yeah, I'm starving!
O-oh, I see...

rows.en:
Yuuto, why are you so good at picking out
the carrots? You've gotta eat your veggies too...
You can live just fine without eating carrots.
They're good for your health, you know?

If you force yourself to eat stuff you hate,
the stress is what'll make you sick.
I don't think that's true...
And the proof is that I'm perfectly healthy.
Well, I guess that's true...
Thanks for the meal today.
So? Delicious, right?
Yeah, big portions too. Great place.

Glad you liked it.
Well then, shall we go do a little shopping?
Yeah, definitely.
